propositions: binding_store.py exceeds maintainability limits due to co-located concerns (file I/O, tempfiles, JSON encoding, rotation, retirement, alerts) and requires extraction without introducing silent data loss
direct extraction of BindingRepository must preserve byte-exact round trips for legacy records and unknown fields without triggering eager rewrites
repository unit-of-work must durably attempt GET rotation before live replacement, retain inline rotation floor on sidecar write failure, and perform retired-first moves in strict order
BindingStore public facade (constructor, loader, signatures, shared dictionaries, exceptions, all_bindings compatibility) must remain unchanged after internal delegation refactoring
tickets publication in reconcile_helpers.py must stage only the existing five bridge-state files and produce no commit on unchanged HEAD
fault injection tests must verify surviving file/byte combinations, raise versus swallow behavior, and exact JSON serialization (sorted, indented, trailing newline) for each failure mode
